title: Impact of Foot Orthoses on Gait in Individuals With Ataxia
official: Prospective Evaluation of Functional Performance in Patients With Lower Limb Orthoses
summary: This study is the first to assess the impact of lower extremity orthoses on gait and balance in individuals with CA. By investigating how orthoses influence mobility and stability, this research will provide critical data to inform clinical guidelines, improve patient care, and support evidence-based orthotic prescriptions for individuals with CA.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Cerebellar ataxia diagnosed by a physician
* Ambulatory for 16 feet (Zeno mat) with assistance and without assistive device(s)
* 18 years or older

Exclusion Criteria:

* Gait velocity \>/= 100 cm/sec without an assistive device
* Medically diagnosed orthopedic conditions or injuries that impact ambulation
* Unhealed wounds on the feet
